description: This file contains the implementation of the Mail class within the OpenCart System Library namespace. It provides various methods for configuring and sending emails, including setting recipients, sender information, subject, message content (text and HTML), attachments, and executing the send operation.
external_files: Opencart\System\Library\Mail\<specific adaptor classes, e.g., mail.php or other adaptor implementations>

classes.name: Mail
classes.description: A class that manages email composition and transmission, supporting setting recipients, sender, subject, message body, attachments, and sending emails through different adaptors.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Mail object with a specified adaptor and options, loading the appropriate adaptor class.

methods.name: setSender
methods.description: Specifies the sender's name or identifier.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the plain text message body of the email.

methods.name: setHtml
methods.description: Sets the HTML content of the email.

methods.name: addAttachment
methods.description: Adds a file attachment to the email.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Performs validation checks and sends the email using the configured adaptor.
